result.name: moby-bikes
result.title: Moby Bikes API
result.notes:
Moby is a licensed dockless bike-share scheme within the Dublin region. This page includes an API developed according to the General Bikeshare Feed Specification (GBFS) (e.g.) information about vehicles, stations, pricing, etc. The current location of the vehicles is updated every five minutes. In addition, this page includes historical files of bike location data.  

Disclaimer - Please note that some of the historical files are empty due to historical data issues.
